subject: inox_l9_bootstrap_repair_and_full_runtime_behavior_validation
authority_source: Principal request to continue L9 debugging and finish putting it in working order; explicit FixBugsFirst doctrine and agent coding attribution requirement
mission: Restore boot of the opt-in L9 object environment and generated stdlib, then verify actual method dispatch and track remaining runtime correctness defects before claiming L9 is fully operational.

checkpoint.result: The scoped L9 and stdlib bootstrap repairs load successfully in INOX_WITH_L9=1; 16 targeted executable behavior cases pass. Original minimal CLI must remain unchanged. Other integration suites are run before final publication.
completed_repair_steps: class{ saves the outer code value before entering extend-class{ to avoid dynamic-scope self-recursion
make.task stub explicitly supplies task/ receiver to make{
multiline stdlib verb terminators are attached to the end of the preceding instruction, eliminating phantom missing-verb .
stdlib class extensions are compiled inside initialize-stdlib-classes with matching brace indentation
integer.times is registered with a stack-only tail-recursive helper; direct nested from:to:do: is not presently reliable
agent-authored .nox comments are ASCII-only because non-ASCII source comments cause text-cell assertions
known_remaining_defects: make.task still contains a visible stub and is not the full task maker
from:to:do: does not reliably iterate beyond its first body call in the original bootstrap, and experimental loop rewrite was incomplete; left unchanged
unbounded CSP growth during recursion can overwrite parser memory in the historical JS VM; separate general control-stack correctness fix needed
L9 actor, promise, scheduler and full inheritance semantics lack a dedicated end-to-end suite
stdlib.nox is marked derived but no checked-in generator was found; regeneration needs a reproducible source

next_packet_candidate: Test and repair the general from:to:do: control/local semantics and overflow-safe CSP, then exercise task, promise and actor workflows with observability and regression fixtures under Inox #16.
